title: TelemetryRejectedEvent
description: Value of one Kafka record on topic telemetry.rejected.v1 (key = agentId), one per rejected event of an ingest batch (FR-ING-07, AT-02). Spec CAP-PFE-2026-TEL-084 section 8.3: 'rejected event fragment, reason code'. index, eventId, code and message are exactly the entry of the 202 response's rejections list (spec 8.1); agentId, batchId and receivedAt are defined as in telemetry-raw-event.1.0.json.

agentId.description: Agent that sent the batch, as authenticated by its API key.

batchId.description: batchId of the ingest request that carried this event (tracing).

receivedAt.description: Gateway clock (UTC) when the HTTP request was received.

index.description: Position of the event in the request's events array.

eventId.description: The event's eventId as sent, or null when it is missing or not a string. Not trusted: it may break the UUID format.

code.description: Reason code (libs/telemetry-contracts/README.md). One code per event: the first rule broken.

message.description: Human-readable reason, the same text as in the 202 response.

event.description: The rejected event exactly as the agent sent it (the 'fragment' of spec 8.3). Any JSON value, because a schema violation may mean it is not even an object. Never trusted by consumers.
